Antarctic Expedition Guide

Grounded in your 9 3D assets & polar references

Emperor, King & Gentoo Penguins

Antarctica hosts 18 penguin species. Gentoo and Chinstrap penguins climb rocky and snowy mountain slopes over 100m high to keep nests dry, belly-tobogganing down glacial runs to feed on krill. Emperor penguins (up to 130 cm, 23 kg) breed on winter ice shelves.

Antarctic Fur Seals & True Seals

Six seal species inhabit Antarctica: Fur, Leopard, Ross, Southern Elephant (males up to 5,000 kg), Crabeater, and Weddell seals. Antarctic Fur Seals (`eared_seal_statuette.glb`) have external ears, thick dark-brown underfur, and strong foreflippers to prop themselves upright on coastal floes.

Orcas & Baleen Whales

Pods of Humpback whales, Minke whales, and apex-predator Orcas (reaching nearly 10 m) patrol the icy channels right alongside expedition Zodiacs, spy-hopping and breaching near the sea-ice edge.

Albatross & Giant Petrels

Seabirds including Wandering Albatross (3.5m wingspan) and Southern Giant Petrels ride katabatic updrafts along the snow mountain ridges and coastal cliffs.

Antarctica has zero terrestrial mammals and a remarkably short, 4-level marine food chain driven by seasonal sea ice:

Level 1 — Primary Producers: Phytoplankton

Microscopic photosynthetic algae blooming along the melting sea-ice edge in polar sunlight.

Level 2 — Keystone Consumer: Antarctic Krill

2-inch crustaceans grazing on phytoplankton; the foundational food source for penguins, seals, squid, and baleen whales.

Level 3 — Mid-Trophic Predators: Penguins, Fish & Seals

18 penguin species, squid, fish, Crabeater/Weddell/Fur/Elephant seals feeding on krill and fish; Leopard seals also prey on penguins.

Level 4 — Apex Predator: Orca (Killer Whale)

Reaching ~10m at the top of the Southern Ocean food chain, hunting blubber-rich seals and fish in freezing waters.

1. penguin (2).glb — Rigged skeletal mesh with 5 animations (Iddle, Walk, Slide, Bite, Fall). Cloned via custom SkeletonUtils across the mountain slopes & avatar.
2. penguin.glb & 3. penguin (1).glb — Emperor & Gentoo colony meshes raycast-snapped onto the mountain terraces, ridge trails, and coastal ice shelf.
4. eared_seal_statuette.glb — Color-graded into lifelike dark-brown wet fur Antarctic Fur Seals on coastal ice floes & beaches.
5. snow_mountain.glb — Towering 3D glacial massif with slope-based rock/snow PBR shader and exact THREE.Raycaster terrain grounding.
6. animated_ocean_scene_tutorial_example_1.glb — Sculpted Southern Ocean wave mesh with Fresnel sky reflections & live Gerstner swell.
7–9. Snow007C, Snow010A & polystyrene_4k ZIPs — PBR Color, NormalGL & Roughness maps applied across the mountain slopes, glacier shelf, and sea-ice floes.
Controls • WASD / Arrows: Climb Mountain & Roam • Drag Canvas: Look 360° • Shift: Sprint / Belly Toboggan • Click Wildlife: Focus & Inspect
